title: Te Kaiwhaiwhai i waenganui i ngā Pae e Rua
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka ārahi a te Atua, ka tū motuhake tētahi tangata hei rangatira mana, hei pononga whakaiti hoki nā Allah. I haere tēnei tangata ki ngā pito tawhiti o te ao, me te mātakitaki i te putanga mai o te rā ki runga i tētahi iwi rerekē, me te tōnga ki roto i tētahi puna pango pōuriuri. Ko te mea whakamiharo, i tukuna ki tēnei pononga te mahi ki te hanga i tētahi ārai whakamiharo hei ārai i tētahi iwi kino nui. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata rongonui mai i te Quran?
clues: I homai e te Atua Aroha ki ahau te mana me te awe i runga i te whenua
I haere ahau ki te wāhi e whiti ai te rā, e tō ai hoki
I tae atu ahau ki tētahi iwi kāore i te tino mārama ki tētahi kupu
I whakahaua ahau kia hanga he ārai nui ki te rino
I hiritia e au te āputa i waenganui i ngā maunga pari e rua ki te konganuku rewa
Ehara ahau i te anahera, ehara hoki i te poropiti, engari he pononga i atawhaitia e te Atua

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Dhu al-Qarnayn (Te Mea he Rua ōna Haona)
Kingi Suleiman (Hōromona)
Poropiti a Dhul-Kifl
Dhu al-Nun (Te Hoa Ika)
Te Anahera o te Ārai
identity.answer: Dhu al-Qarnayn (Te Mea he Rua ōna Haona)

trial.label: Te Mahi Nui

Te hanga i tētahi ārai rino nui hei ārai i a Yajuj rāua ko Majuj
Te hanga i tētahi torona koura mō te whakawa
Te keri i te puna hohonu mō te hunga tika
Te hanga kaipuke i te wā o te waipuke nui
trial.answer: Te hanga i tētahi ārai rino nui hei ārai i a Yajuj rāua ko Majuj

location.label: Te Tautuhinga
options: Te whenua o Uzair i waenganui i ngā awa e rua
Te wāhi o te whitinga o te rā me te puna paru pango
Te awaawa tapu o Makkah
Te koraha o Madyan
Te moutere o Kaiperu
location.answer: Te wāhi o te whitinga o te rā me te puna paru pango

outcome.label: Te Kupu Whakaari Atua
options: Ka tukuna tonutia te pararaiha mutunga kore

outcome.answer: Ka mau te ārai tae noa ki te Rā Whakawa

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
